CustomField.description: Which chat/LLM provider GtmAgentProxyController.runLoop() calls for GUS. Anthropic is the default and preserves pre-existing behavior when left blank/unset. Plain Text (not Picklist) because GTM_Agent_Settings__c is a Hierarchy Custom Setting and Custom Settings do not support Picklist fields -- the 'Anthropic'/'OpenAI'/'Gemini'/'Agentforce' value constraint is enforced at the Apex layer in GtmAgentSettingsController.setAgentSettings() instead.
CustomField.label: Chat Provider
